cases.description: Validate that getKeyword() returns the string value of a normal keyword (e.g., Keyword.TYPE) when the validator is constructed with that keyword.
Validate that getKeyword() correctly returns a different keyword value (e.g., Keyword.PROPERTIES) to ensure the method does not hard‑code any particular string.
Validate that getKeyword() throws a NullPointerException when the internal `keyword` field is null (simulating a mis‑configured validator).
